name: Workshop PPE & General Safety
description: Verifies mandatory personal protective equipment, first aid station availability, floor cleanliness, and cable hazards.
disclaimer: AuditLens is an assistive pre-audit tool. It does not certify legal compliance. Verify against local regulations and a qualified inspector.

rules.title: Personnel inside workshop wear hard hats / safety helmets
rules.fix_text: Mandate hard hat compliance at all designated workshop entry points and provide helmets for all active personnel.

rules.title: Personnel handling equipment wear protective safety gloves
rules.fix_text: Provide cut-resistant safety gloves and enforce mandatory use during active machinery and material handling.

rules.title: Workshop walkways and work bays are free of loose floor clutter
rules.fix_text: Clean workshop floor, implement daily 5S housekeeping routines, and store loose materials in designated bins.

rules.title: First aid kit or station is accessible and clearly marked
rules.fix_text: Install a fully stocked, wall-mounted first aid kit in a central, visible location with clear signage.

rules.title: No loose or unbridged power cords across walkways
rules.fix_text: Reroute power cables overhead or install heavy-duty floor cable bridge protectors across walkway crossings.
